a.lede: Huang built Nvidia as a family business but after the co-founder had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, its board faces a difficult decision For more than 30 years, Jensen Huang has been the seemingly unshakable public face of Nvidia. a.title: Jensen Huang’s image has been shattered. Could he be pushed out at Nvidia?
